items.information: The cost of registration is $7+2n where n is the number of events you are competing in. Registration closes December 6th at 11:59 PM PST; please be sure to register before then! We **will not** be taking registration at the door.

items.information: Kubo Open 2016 is one of the year end competion in the Philippines. Kubo is a Filipino term for an English word "cube". That's why is was name Kubo Open 2016. The competition will take place at the Philippine Nikkei Jin Kai International School located at the Mamay Rd, Lanang, Davao City. This will be on the 10th to 11th of December 2016 that will be Saturday and Sunday. Registration is only P250.00 good for 3 events 50 for each of the additional events.

venue.details: The brown building with disco lights outside.

items.information: A small and cozy competition in the small town Kungsbacka . A one-day competition open for everyone. Participation fee: 150 SEK. Registration is not accepted until the registration fee is paid. More information about registration/payment can be found under payment Initial limitation of contestants is 35. Registration closes latest December 2nd or when the limit is reached. There are many resturants and grocery stores close to the venue. It's a great opportunity to go Christmas Shopping and on Sunday you could visit the theme park "Jul på Liseberg" in Gothenburg.
